newsitem.title: POLAND: Zywiec rebounds five pct after falls.
newsitem.headline: Zywiec rebounds five pct after falls.

text.p: Polish brewer Zywiec SA, Thursday's main market top gainer on the Warsaw bourse, rose five percent to 137.5 zlotys in 2.2-million zloty trade, rebounding after a big fall on Tuesday, traders said.
"It's a rebound after the big fall," one trader said about the stock's 10-percent drop on Tuesday.
Zywiec, which inched up 0.4 percent on Wednesday, plunged after it said on Monday it was shutting down one of its breweries, phasing-out soft-drink production and sacking 145 of its 990 employees.
